note: Hand-written topical queries for the PubMed RAG bake-off — the 'is the top of the list any good' family, where many citations are relevant and none is THE answer. Paired EN/SV per CLAUDE.md invariant 6; the Swedish side is idiomatic clinical/research Swedish with CORRECT DIACRITICS, not a gloss. Stripping diacritics costs orders of magnitude of retrieval score and has already manufactured a false invariant-6 bug report once (docs/PUBMED-RAG.md §7.7), so any edit here keeps them. Graded by an LLM judge in `rag-eval.mjs judge`, so the set stays small enough to grade honestly. The index holds the 2026 update files, so every query is phrased to have plausible recent literature rather than pointing at a landmark trial from 2008.

controls.why: the HARD control: real research, real technical vocabulary, but arXiv's subject matter rather than PubMed's. A floor tuned only against nonsense will let this through, and this index answering a machine-learning systems question is exactly the confident-nonsense failure the floor exists to prevent.
